items.title: 32.4 Viral infections ke ilaj ki mushkilat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.4 with Quick Check 32.1 answered, printed page 233 (PDF 236). The antiviral diagram is our aid.

blocks.text: Viral infections ka ilaaj bacterial infections ke ilaaj se bunyadi taur par mukhtalif hai. Bacteria khud-mukhtar (apne aap zinda rehne wale) jaandaar hain, jab ke viruses parasites (doosron par palne wale) hain. Bacteria ki tarah viruses akele sahi maanon mein zinda nahi hote. Viruses hamare cells ke andar rehte hain aur apni copies banane (replicate) ke liye hamari apni DNA/RNA machinery istemal karte hain. Is liye aisi dawa banana mushkil hai jo virus ko maare magar hamare sehatmand cells ko nuqsan na de.

blocks.title: Mutation
blocks.text: Viruses apna genetic material bohat jaldi badal sakte hain. Isay mutation kehte hain.
Jo dawa aik saal kisi virus ke khilaf kaam karti hai, woh agle saal shayad kaam na kare, kyunke virus badal chuka hota hai. Isi liye flu ki vaccines har saal update karni parti hain.

Viruses hamare genome (cell ke poore genetic material) mein shamil ho kar saalon tak soye (inactive) reh sakte hain. Aaj kal ki dawaiyan sirf active viruses ko maar sakti hain, un ko nahi jo saalon se soye hue hain.

Antiviral dawaiyan virus ki zindagi ke kisi khaas marhale (stage) ko nishana banati hain. Maslan kuch antivirals virus ko hamare cells mein dakhil hone se rokti hain, aur kuch virus ko apna genetic material copy karne se rokti hain. Antiviral dawaiyon ka sab se aam tareeqa enzyme inhibition (enzyme ko kaam se rokna) hai. Maslan protease inhibitor virus ke protease enzyme ko rokta hai, jo virus ki lambi protein lari (strand) ko kaam ke proteins mein kaat'ta hai. Yeh inhibitors HIV aur hepatitis C ke ilaaj mein bhi madad dete hain. Kuch antiviral dawaiyan jism ka immune response (bimari se larne ka nizam) mazboot karti hain. Interferons aise proteins hain jo immune system ko viruses se larne ke liye taqat dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke protease inhibitor “virus ko apna protein aik lambi lari mein banane nahi deta”. Asal mein virus apne proteins aik lambi lari (polyprotein) ki shakal mein hi banata hai, aur us ka protease enzyme is lari ko kaam ke proteins mein kaat'ta hai. Protease inhibitor yeh kaatna rokta hai, is liye naye viruses mukammal nahi ban paate.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam baen se daen: virus cell mein dakhil, genetic maddah ki copy, lambi protein lari protease se kat'ti, naye viruses bahar. Pehle teen qadmon ke neeche surkh X ke saath dawaon ke khane: entry blockers, copying blockers, protease inhibitors.
blocks.caption: Antiviral dawayein virus ki zindagi ke kis qadam par asar karti hain (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: a) Drug A ka TI 3 aur Drug B ka TI 50 hai. Kaun si dawa zyada mehfooz hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Drug B. Is ki zehreeli dose faida dene wali dose se 50 guna hai, jab ke Drug A mein sirf 3 guna; is liye B mein hifazat ki gunjaish kaheen zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Antacids (maslan magnesium hydroxide, Mg(OH)₂) maide ka pH kaise control karte hain? Neutralization ki saada equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Antacid base hai; yeh maide ke zyada HCl ko neutralize kar ke pH barha deta hai: Mg(OH)₂ + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + 2H₂O.

blocks.prompt: c) Penicillin mein woh bunyadi, tani hui (strained) heterocyclic ring pehchanein jo is ke antibacterial asar ke liye zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: Four-membered beta-lactam ring (jo thiazolidine ring se juri hai).

blocks.prompt: d) Morphine aur codeine (methylmorphine) ki banawat compare karein. Yeh chhota sa farq codeine ke prodrug hone se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Codeine woh morphine hai jis ka aik phenolic OH group OCH₃ mein badla hua hai. Is wajah se codeine opioid receptors se kamzor jurti hai; jigar mein codeine ka methyl group hat kar woh morphine ban jaati hai, aur zyada tar dard yahi morphine door karti hai. Is liye codeine prodrug (jism ke andar asal dawa mein badalne wali dawa) hai.

blocks.prompt: e) Bohat si antiviral dawaiyan mareez ke liye zyada side effects kyun deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Virus mareez ke apne cells ki machinery se copies banata hai, is liye virus ko rokne wali dawa mareez ke sehatmand cells ke kaam mein bhi dakhal de sakti hai.

items: Viruses hamare cells ke andar reh kar hamari DNA/RNA machinery use karte hain.
Mutation: virus jaldi badalta hai, is liye flu vaccine har saal nayi.
Soye hue viruses par aaj ki dawaiyan asar nahi karti.
Antivirals: dakhla rokna, copy rokna, enzyme inhibition (protease inhibitors); interferons immunity barhate hain.
